HGraph Zoo Visualization Report

1. What this file contains

This report visualizes hgraph_zoo.pt, a PyG HeteroData package containing model nodes, dataset nodes, model-dataset edges, dataset-dataset similarity edges, and optional model-model lineage edges.

contain_model_feature: True

  • name_dim: 64
  • desc_dim: 384
  • num_size_buckets: 15
  • num_families: 136
